verdict: Organic visibility is sliding across all three brands; root-cause fix is in motion.
narrative: Across Forte Precision Metals, Advance Grinding Services, and O'Hare Precision Metals, your combined Google Business Profile activity totalled 370 actions this period — all organic, with no paid spend active on any brand. Over the last 7 days, GBP engagement and search click-through dropped sharply on Forte (down 85%) and O'Hare (down 48%), and search clicks fell 42% at Advance Grinding — a consistent pattern pointing to a visibility issue rather than isolated fluctuations. A web and SEO root-cause fix has been identified and is being submitted; reindexing across all three sites is the targeted outcome by end of October. You should expect search impressions and GBP engagement to remain soft in the near term before recovering as the fix takes hold.
